svg.title: Four Base Seats; Six People at Scale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-seat-equipment-brokerage-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Base Seats; Six People at Scale; subtitle: One full-time owner and three contractors divide commercial and evidence work.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each numeric value represents one person in the four-person Conservative and Base pod: 1 FT + 3 C. Contractor seats represent assigned responsibilities, not necessarily full-time workloads. Scaled expands to 2 FT + 4 C by adding one full-time commercial operator and one contractor inspection specialist.; caption: Conservative: $100,000 revenue and $25,000 owner net with 1 FT + 3 C. Base: $450,000 revenue and $157,500 owner net with the same four people. Scaled: $800,000 revenue and $360,000 owner net with 2 FT + 4 C. The upper revenue scenario uses six people, not the four-person Base pod.; stages: label: Owner and commercial lead; value: One full-time seat owns mandates, pricing, and broker revenue; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own seller qualification, buyer negotiation, signed mandates, and commission collection. Review exceptions without personally controlling every evidence source. At scale, add a second full-time commercial operator to split seller development and buyer conversion.; label: Technical inspection specialist; value: One contractor seat owns independent equipment condition evidence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Produce serial-specific inspection reports, photograph defects, document test limitations, and estimate repair scope separately from sale pricing. Add a second contractor inspection specialist at scale to expand equipment coverage and reduce scheduling bottlenecks.; label: Inventory and buyer research analyst; value: One contractor seat owns inventory matching and buyer alerts; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Normalize Airtable inventory records, deduplicate owner and asset identities, maintain HubSpot buyer segments, and route relevant alerts. Measure qualified matches and buyer replies rather than counting raw messages.; label: Transaction coordinator; value: One contractor seat owns documents and independent settlement reconciliation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Track lien searches, creditor documents, signatures, inspection acceptance, and escrow statements. Require separate verification of changed payment instructions; the person entering a new bank destination must not be its sole verifier.
